text: City of Newark City Clerk’s Office 37101 Newark Boulevard Newark, CA 94560 NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the City Council of the City of Newark at its City Council meeting on Thursday, July 23, 2026, at or after 7:00 p.m. will consider annual adjustments to existing fees for services or functions performed by the City in a governmental and/or proprietary capacity previously established in accordance with the Mitigation Fee Act, pursuant to Government Code Sections 66000 et seq. Specifically, amendments will be made to the Fiscal Year 2026-2027 Master Fee Schedule to provide for an annual adjustment to the development impact fees for various building permits. Data establishing the estimated cost required to provide the service for which the fee or service charge is levied and the revenue sources anticipated to provide the service are available to the public at the Office of the City Clerk. Please email the City Clerk at city.clerk@newark.org or call 510-578-4278 to obtain a copy. Further details on how to participate in the meeting will be set forth in the meeting agenda which is anticipated to be posted by 5 pm on July 16, 2026 at https://www.newarkca.gov/departments/city-manager-s-office/meetingsagendas-minutes. If you have any questions regarding viewing or participating in the meeting, after reviewing the posted agenda, then contact the City Clerk at city.clerk@newark.org. If you challenge a City action in court, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice or in written correspondence delivered to the City of Newark at, or prior to, the public hearing. Certification of Public Hearing Notice This notice is also posted on the City’s website and on the City Hall bulletin board located at 37101 Newark Boulevard, Newark, CA, at least 72 hours prior to the meeting date, in accordance with the Ralph M. Brown Act. For further inquiries, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (510) 578-4266.
